nextStoryContext: US-007 added 'stage-promoted' to WorkerEventKind (events.ts) and StagePromotedEventDetail { id, fromStage, toStage } to the WorkerEventDetail union. specifyIssueOnMain now emits this event on successful commit only, using an injected WorkerEventLogger (eventSink option) that defaults to makeFileEventLogger(<cwd>/.claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl) -- the canonical production sink. emitStagePromoted() is a private helper extracted to keep specifyIssueOnMain under 80 lines (biome noExcessiveLinesPerFunction). Three new tests were added: (1) injected sink captures event on success, (2) no event on guard failure, (3) production-wiring test that omits eventSink and asserts the file gets written. makeOpts() default is a no-op eventSink to prevent filesystem side-effects in unit tests. Real-git integration tests pass eventSink: () => {} to keep tmpdir working trees clean. US-008 is next: add a recovery-runbook entry for the grill / spec flow.
